posts.author: andrewgwils
posts.name: Andrew Gordon Wilson
posts.text:
Stochastic weight averaging (SWA) just keeps coming back, often rebranded as model merging. A simple equal average of params with constant LR is less sensitive to hypers, generalizes better, and is more adaptable to new settings. Give it a try! 
https://
arxiv.org/abs/1803.05407
posts.quoted: Trick #3: Merge, merge, merge. In pretraining, we skipped LR decay for a running weight average. Then we merged pre-context-extension models into post-extension checkpoints (see fig. for ablation study gains). Merging was also an expedient stand-in for MOPD in our RLVR recipe.
